crossRefs.note: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Peor
people.line: A mountain in Moab associated with idolatry

translations.web: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
translations.bsb: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.
translations.kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
translations.asv: And Balak took Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh down upon the desert.
